candidate.definition_en: Having great influence on someone or something; powerful and effective.
candidate.explanation_ar: مؤثر، يعني شخص أو شيء عنده قوة وقدرة إنه يغير في آراء الناس أو الأحداث.

senses.definition_en: Having great influence on someone or something; powerful and effective.
senses.definition_ar: مؤثر وله نفوذ وقدرة على توجيه الأحداث والآراء.

examples: She became an influential figure in the company.
His book was very influential in the 1990s.
The philosopher's influential treatise changed modern thought.
candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Influence' 'تأثير'.. الشخص الـ 'Influential' هو اللي كلمته مسموعة.
